title: Local optimization of weak distance between compact surfaces on special Euclidean group
summary: We consider local optimization of a weak distance between two compact surfaces embedded in the three-dimensional Euclidean space on its special Euclidean group. Identifying those objects with the associated surface measures, their discrepancy is quantified in terms of the inhomogeneous Sobolev norm of negative order via the Plancherel theorem. Then, applying an isometry to one surface corresponds to pushforwarding its surface measure and the distance can be regarded as a function on the Lie group.
